title: Personally owned Windows devices are enrolled

report.title: {Items.Count} personally owned Windows {Plural(Items.Count, 'device is', 'devices are')} enrolled

messages.businessImpact: Company policy and data are on hardware the organisation does not own, cannot recover and cannot dispose of securely when the person leaves.
remediation: Decide whether these should be there. Where they should not, block personal Windows enrolment and retire them.
Where personal access is intended, deliver it through app protection rather than enrolment.
messages.cannotSee: Ownership is what Intune recorded at enrolment, which an administrator can change afterwards and which a corporate device enrolled through a personal route can carry wrongly. Whether personal enrolment is intended is a decision the tenant has made elsewhere, which ENR-002 reads.
